issues.description: targetGasUsed implements ceiling division `(gasLimit + slack -1) / slack` whereas spec defines gas target as floor division `parent_gas_limit // ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER`. For any gas_limit not exactly divisible by elasticity multiplier the target differs by 1.
issues.potential_impact: Off-by-one gas target causes divergent base_fee_per_gas calculation vs spec reference, leading to invalid block acceptance/rejection and consensus split with spec-compliant clients.
issues.spec_reference: parent_gas_target = self.parent(block).gas_limit // ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER // Note: `//` is integer division, round down.
issues.suggestion: Change to floor division: `return blockHeader.getGasLimit() / getSlackCoefficient();` to match spec.

issues.code_location: BaseFeeMarket.computeBaseFee() - abstract, no implementation in file
issues.description: Critical consensus logic - base fee update formula with `max(...,1)` minimum increase on congestion, decrease without floor, fork-block INITIAL_BASE_FEE handling, and parent gas_target derivation - is abstracted away. This file alone does not enforce BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR=8, ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER=2, INITIAL_BASE_FEE=1000000000, nor fork-block special case where parent_gas_target = parent.gas_limit and limit check uses parent_gas_limit * ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER.
issues.potential_impact: If concrete implementation omits max(delta,1), mishandles underflow when parent_base_fee_per_gas - delta, or misses fork-block initialization, base fee can stall, underflow, or diverge from canonical chain causing consensus failure. Transaction checks `max_fee_per_gas >= base_fee`, `max_fee >= max_priority_fee`, priority_fee capping, burn (miner gets only priority_fee) and GASPRICE==effective_gas_price are also absent from this file.
issues.suggestion: Verify concrete LondonFeeMarket implementation enforces exact spec formula, floor division target, max(...,1) increase, INITIAL_BASE_FEE on fork block, correct constants, and that fee-cap/priority-fee/burn/GASPRICE checks exist elsewhere.

summary: This file is only a parameter/validation-mode interface and does not itself implement EIP-1559 consensus rules. Its targetGasUsed uses ceiling instead of spec-mandated floor division, and all critical base-fee computation, fork-block handling, fee-cap, priority-fee and burn logic is delegated elsewhere and cannot be verified here.
